name: fullstack-agent-unified-installer
summary: Single-command interactive setup CLI tool to install and configure modular Jarvis sub-systems for Claude Code.
steps: Install Claude Code CLI environment
Clone and execute fullstack-agent installer script
Interactively select desired sub-systems (Memory Vault, Voice, Visualizer, Barehands)
jarvis_use: Automate unified setup of modular Jarvis sub-systems on Mac operator workspace.

name: multi-llm-standalone-repo-fallback
summary: Modular deployment fallback using standalone repositories independently when operating on non-Claude LLM backends.
steps: Identify non-Claude target LLM system
Bypass unified fullstack-agent setup script
Clone standalone repositories (ai-memory-vault, ai-visualizer, barehands)
Integrate standalone sub-systems individually excluding backtalk
jarvis_use: Enable individual Jarvis modules across non-Claude LLM providers.

name: plain-text-memory-vault
summary: Folder-based plain-text persistence system loaded into prompt context at startup and updated during execution.
steps: Maintain dedicated local folder containing plain text files
Inject plain text file contents into agent context at session startup
Dynamically append task notes and context updates back to text files during active work
jarvis_use: Maintain zero-dependency persistent memory across execution sessions on Mac.

name: hotkey-push-to-talk-voice-pipeline
summary: Hotkey-triggered audio recording and low-latency voice feedback pipeline powered by Claude SDK.
steps: Press and hold designated hotkey to initiate recording
Speak audio prompt into system microphone
Release hotkey to stream audio payload to Claude SDK
Receive and output synthesized audio response through system speakers
jarvis_use: Provide fast push-to-talk voice command interaction for desktop operator workflow.

name: animated-state-hud-visualizer
summary: Fullscreen animated state indicator visualizer reflecting agent status (listening, thinking, speaking).
steps: Launch fullscreen visualizer interface
Select UI theme (such as animated circuit board design)
Connect visualizer to agent execution state bus
Render live state feedback (listening, thinking, or speaking)
jarvis_use: Provide clear visual operational feedback of background AI agent status.

name: barehands-camera-gesture-control
summary: Camera-driven spatial gesture tracking overlay window for touchless control of screen components.
steps: Open barehands window interface as alternative to visualizer
Capture video stream from web camera
Extract hand coordinates using spatial gesture tracking model
Translate detected gestures into screen element triggers
jarvis_use: Enable hardware-free, camera-based gesture control of Mac desktop interface.

name: web-link-overlay-scene-presentation
summary: Interactive presentation rendering display showing generated scenes with embedded web link overlays.
steps: Render generated 3D interior scene display
Overlay clickable web link target overlays on designated scene anchors
Display interactive scene window to user
jarvis_use: Display interactive 3D spatial presentation scenes with actionable web link anchors.
